post.summary: Submit an AI agent initiated payout through the Trust Gateway
post.description: Internal agentic commerce contract (Person 3). The caller states which registered agent is acting and which delegation authorizes it; the server resolves the agent identity, the authorization context and the merchant identity, then normalizes the request into the canonical payout request handled by the Trust Gateway. No payment provider is contacted from this endpoint and no trust state can be asserted by the caller.

get.summary: List incident evidence seals for the authenticated merchant
Read one evidence seal and verify consistency of its recorded range
get.description: Seal-range verification checks sequence continuity, payload hashes, chain links and the sealed head. It is not a per-record notarisation.

Aggregates a complete, bounded record set for the authenticated merchant. The response is flagged when the range exceeds the server scan cap; client-side metrics are never derived from a single paginated page.

AgenticCommerceRequest.title: AgenticCommerceRequest
AgenticCommerceRequest.description:
An AI agent initiated commerce / payout request.

This is the inbound half of the internal adapter contract. It carries the
agent reference, the authorization reference and the intended transaction.
It carries no identity claim: merchant, user and session authority are
resolved from the authenticated principal and the server side registry.

AgenticCommerceResponse.title: AgenticCommerceResponse
AgenticCommerceResponse.description:
Trust Gateway outcome for an agent initiated request.

The gateway response is preserved verbatim and the agent provenance is
attached, so the caller can attribute the result to the acting agent.
